question: Does a multi-scale strain-gradient structure-tensor channel improve the existing geophysical/topographic/radiometric context detector on a spatially blocked holdout?

data_provenance.retrieval: Read-only sparse checkout of public team repository buffedlizard55-lab/5GEMSDOE at commit 6e8d28ba407b5d748de5b3e94635c41d95e35354; assembled only in excluded .cache/; no data rasters added to this repo.
data_provenance.manifest: data/bridge/manifest.json in that repository; SHA-256 of each assembled full file independently matched the manifest.
data_provenance.direct_official_portal: The official DrivenData data tab redirected to login in this environment. The mirrored bytes match the pinned repository manifest, whose provenance describes the competition-page Dropbox mirrors; that origin chain is repository-recorded rather than independently re-downloaded from DrivenData here.

method.candidate_channels_detail: coherence, cos(2*orientation), sin(2*orientation), and log edge energy at Gaussian structure-tensor sigmas 2.5 and 7.5 pixels (approximately 0.5 km and 1.5 km)
method.control_auxiliary_data: 9-band topographic feature raster and 7-band radiometric raster, SHA-256 verified against their public bridge manifests; same inputs used in both arms.
method.model: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier from scripts/train_context_detector.py at the pinned 5GEMSDOE commit; same 19+16 feature control model versus 19+16+8 H1 model
method.fold_geometry: Deterministic balanced assignment of contiguous 512x512 blocks into four folds; 3-pixel collar around held-out geography excluded from training.
method.scoring_adjustment: For validation scores, fold truth was restricted to labels in the held-out blocks only (matching the new-fault-only target more closely); predictions were evaluated only in those blocks, while the 300 m neighborhood around held-out truths remained available for TP credit. False-positive distance weights used held-out labels only, not catalogue labels from training folds.
method.scoring_patch_applied_to_pinned_runner: For each fold: sc_mask = scored_mask((H, W), block_px, fold_of, fold); fold_ctx = GtContext((labels & sc_mask).astype(np.float32), DEFAULT_R_PIXELS); score_within_mask(prob, fold_ctx, sc_mask). The same fold_ctx/sc_mask pair was used for each fixed-threshold sweep.
method.baseline_rerun_note: The prior team's saved context-detector reports use global catalogue geometry for FP weighting. Those scores are not directly compared here; both control and H1 were freshly rerun with the identical held-out-label-only scoring patch.
method.metric: Official distance-weighted Tversky definition: alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, triangular distance support=300 m (3 pixels). Predictions thresholded at 0.20 for the preregistered comparison.
method.threshold_note: 0.20 was the top threshold among the control's tested sweep for this run. It was fixed and applied equally to the H1 arm; this same-holdout threshold selection makes the result a screening comparison, not an unbiased final estimate.

h1.name: control channels + H1 strain structure-tensor channels

results.decision: H1 did not beat the paired control/current best screening score. Two folds declined and two improved; overall DTI was slightly lower. Treat this as no demonstrated improvement, not as proof that strain structure is useless. Do not submit H1.

limitations: These are local scores on withheld portions of the existing mapped-fault catalogue, not the private expert test set or confirmed catalogue-gap discoveries.
The data files were hash-verified against a public sibling-project bridge manifest, but were not fetched directly from the authenticated competition portal in this workspace.
One fixed seed and four spatial folds are a screening test; no block bootstrap or multi-seed confidence interval was produced.

Topographic/radiometric auxiliary channels came from team-published bridge artifacts and were held constant across the paired arms; their independent physical provenance is recorded in that bridge, not re-audited here beyond hashes and grid.
No contest submission file was generated from this experiment and no submission slot was used.
